test_cases.name: research_brief
test_cases.input: Write a research brief on the latest advances in agent orchestration for enterprise AI. Make it look professional and scannable.
assertions: Produces structured output with sections and tables
Grounds visual choices in the subject of AI agents

test_cases.name: daily_digest
test_cases.input: Create a daily technology signal digest covering AI model releases and cloud infrastructure news. Make it visual and easy to scan.
assertions: Uses clear hierarchy and tables or bullets
Prefers professional format or rich structured markdown

test_cases.name: decision_memo
test_cases.input: Prepare a one-page decision memo on whether to adopt a new inference platform. Include options, tradeoffs, and a recommendation.
assertions: Structures with recommendation, options table, and clear sections
Applies restraint and one memorable element
Does not use fixed theme presets
